name: mac-mail
description: Local Apple Mail access for efficient indexed search, optional private body search, easy mailbox targeting, permission diagnostics, self-update checks, inbox overviews, bounded reads, attachment handling, visible drafts, rich .eml draft prep, and approval-gated sending from this Mac.

interface.longDescription: Use local Apple Mail data on this Mac to inspect accounts and mailboxes, search indexed messages across configured inboxes or exact selected mailboxes, diagnose and open macOS permission settings, check/pull GitHub plugin updates, optionally build a private local FTS body cache, generate metadata-only inbox overviews, read downloaded messages and local threads with bounded body output, export reviewed attachments, create visible new/reply/forward drafts or unsent rich .eml draft files, inspect outgoing drafts, and send only through an explicit confirmation gate.
defaultPrompt: Scan recent local Apple Mail inboxes, ignore obvious noise, and bucket what needs attention
Check Mac Mail plugin permissions and open Full Disk Access settings if needed
Check whether the Mac Mail plugin has updates available on GitHub
List Apple Mail mailboxes and search inside one exact mailbox_id
Search downloaded Apple Mail bodies with the private local body index
Read the latest local Apple Mail thread, summarize the ask, and draft a visible reply without sending
Find unread messages across local accounts and state scope plus confidence
Prepare an unsent rich .eml draft file for visible review in Mail
